name: hbm_su_cx_dlq_1018

pin_regs.reason: Every pin is registered in RTL (inputs land in pin registers / banks, every output is a register); a wrapper stage would move the fixed 3:4 seam calendar edges.

structural_change: HBM-CXDL 10-18: the two-root cxport leaves failed route (dl 761317600: TT -166.7 / FF hold -95.1 on 1,045 dl_slot -> dw_d endpoints, hold repair stalled because the same endpoints fail setup; rc: TT -173.4 / FF -77.9 on ro_slot / rr_slot1 -> serial and rc_slot -> pend / rc_d). Cause: NOT tree skew (clk_s / clk_q leaf insertion differ ~47 ps) but the 3:4 crossing inside one leaf, which ordinary related-clock STA times at the VCO tick (setup 277.8 ps, hold at the coincident edge) less the 150 / 100 distinct-entry reserve. Fix (S81 x34 _s/_t and bridge_release_s precedent): each leaf splits into a stream half and a serial half with ONE root each; the crossing becomes a 2-bank seam (events alternate banks; static calendar windows >= 3 quanta for setup and for rewrite-after-read), a die-level 3:4 seam arc. Same edges and outputs: lockstep vs the hub PASS QID 2 and QID 0 (checks=24183, as before); mutants 2/3/4 FAIL. dl_q (serial, die x16): W seam from dl_s 1,065 b (4.9/um), E slice-G write port 1,044 b (4.9/um).
